question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Under the sun
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. On earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Under the sun"** means everything that exists or is possible on Earth. (पृथ्वी पर)

 
 
• **Example:** There is nothing new under the sun.
 
 
 
• **"On earth"** refers to anything that exists or occurs on the planet Earth. (पृथ्वी पर)
 
 
• **Example:** He is the best musician on earth.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. On earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In public** (सार्वजनिक रूप से): Something done openly and in view of others.

 
 
• **Example:** The politician made a speech in public.
 
 
 
• **Under suspicion** (संदेह के घेरे में): Being suspected of something, usually wrongdoing.
 
 
• **Example:** He was under suspicion for the theft.
 
 
 
• **At high risk** (उच्च जोखिम में): Being in a situation where danger or harm is likely.
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking puts you at high risk for lung cancer.
